title: Lovely Crispy Kenyan Braeburn Apple Skillet
description: A festive Kenyan dish featuring crispy Braeburn apples and lardons, served on a slate tile vessel, low in glycemic index and rich in resinous flavors.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium heat on the stovetop.
Add the lardons to the skillet and cook until crispy, then set aside.
Add the sliced apples to the skillet and cook until they start to soften.
Add the grated ginger, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes, or until the apples are tender and crispy.
Remove the skillet from the oven and top with the crispy lardons.
Serve the Lovely Crispy Kenyan Braeburn Apple Skillet hot on a slate tile vessel.
